product_one_liner.value: Lyric provides an enterprise AI platform that lets supply-chain teams build and run tailored optimization, forecasting, planning, and logistics solutions.
product_one_liner.notes: The company’s postings describe an enterprise AI platform specifically for supply chains and enumerate network optimization, inventory allocation, routing, capacity planning, predictions, and scenario analysis. Sources: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lyric/07f709d6-f763-4b19-a246-2cb92e144314 and https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lyric/bd834e1f-3499-4c5c-9302-74d017807618

pricing_page.notes: A public AWS Marketplace pricing page lists access to Lyric Studio as a contract dimension, with contract options and a displayed pricing row. This is marketplace pricing, not a standalone pricing page on lyric.tech. Source: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-kbxc4aoesit6k

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 323 employees, consistent with the company’s statement that its team exceeds 300, placing it in the 201–500 band. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/lyric-tech and https://lyric.tech/about-us

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company overview explicitly identifies Sunnyvale as its headquarters city. Source: https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric | hq_country: The company overview identifies its headquarters as Sunnyvale, California, United States. Source: https://lyric.tech/ai-info-about-lyric

founded_year.notes: The company’s job posting explicitly dates its inception to December 2021. Source: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lyric/07f709d6-f763-4b19-a246-2cb92e144314

eng_blog.notes: Under the requested strict threshold, two engineer-authored posts were not established. The blog index identifies one clear Engineering Insights article, authored by Aditya Jaroli and Pradeep Vijayakumar. A second architecture-oriented article is attributed to the CEO, without establishing an engineering role. Sources: https://lyric.tech/blog?paged=1, https://lyric.tech/blogs-and-whitepapers/the-real-reason-your-planning-system-slows-down and https://lyric.tech/blogs-and-whitepapers/the-technology-behind-modeling-at-scale

public_docs.notes: No public multi-article documentation was available: the homepage resource navigation lacks a docs/help link, docs.lyric.tech requests a Lyric Studio email address, and help.lyric.tech requires authentication. This does not mean documentation is absent for customers. Sources: https://lyric.tech/, https://docs.lyric.tech and https://help.lyric.tech

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live ML (Data) Platform Engineer posting includes an application link and explicitly involves scaling Lyric’s AutoML platform and time-series forecasting, rather than an ordinary data-engineering-only role. Source: http://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lyric/3d922475-95b5-4dad-84ad-5b2e38445ed2

model_provider.notes: No specific AI model or model provider was publicly identified in the product, blog, privacy, security/AI-governance, or subprocessor material reviewed. The platform describes supply-chain-trained models; cloud subprocessors and optimization solvers do not establish an AI-model provider. Product documentation is access-gated. Sources: https://lyric.tech/platform, https://security.lyric.tech/, https://lyric.tech/legal/privacy-policy and https://docs.lyric.tech

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security portal expressly claims ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 attestation. The company overview claims GDPR alignment; GDPR is included as a publicly claimed compliance framework, not as an independently issued certification. raised_18mo.notes: The August 5, 2025 Series B announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. The conflicting current amount does not affect whether funding occurred inside the window. Source: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/lyric-raises-43-5m-series-b-to-transform-supply-chain-decision-making-with-ai-302520358.html

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Enterprise Account Executive posting has an active application link and qualifies under the requested role-title definition. Source: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lyric/bd834e1f-3499-4c5c-9302-74d017807618

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying launch announcement was established for May 9–November 9, 2026 in the readable blog history. The concrete capability announcement found concerns NVIDIA cuOpt in March 2025; the August 2026 demand-forecasting article discusses capabilities without explicitly announcing a launch. This negative finding is less certain than a positive dated announcement. Sources: https://lyric.tech/blog/lyric-leverages-nvidia-cuopt-to-elevate-supply-chain-ai and https://lyric.tech/blogs

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Deb Kennedy’s profile records a December 2025 start as Vice-President, AI Supply Chain Sales at Lyric, within the requested November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window. The profile’s supply-chain and decision-intelligence description identifies the correct Lyric. Source: https://linkedin.com/in/debkennedy938
